deviations: D1: TenantAdminGuard gains two helpers beyond the design signatures: interactive_admin_check/2 (returns :ok | :refused, no rollback) and interactive_refusal/2 (builds the refusal map). Reason: update_locked_user is an Ecto.Multi step and the design's ensure_interactive_admin_remains!/4 calls Repo.rollback, which inside a Multi.run would return a bare 2-tuple instead of the {:error, step, value, changes} the design's section 3.7 P1 mapping needs. ensure_interactive_admin_remains!/4 itself delegates to interactive_admin_check/2, so there is one decision function. P1 therefore calls interactive_admin_check/2 (via private interactive_guard/3), not ensure_interactive_admin_remains!/4; T-LA-30's 'G row calls ensure_interactive_admin_remains!' is encoded per row in LastAdminPaths as :guard_call (:interactive_admin_check for P1) and :guard (function holding the call; for P3/P4 that is guard_unbind_interactive_admin/3 and move_role/6, not the lock-A site do_upsert_role/rebind_transaction). TEST-DESIGNER must key the scan on those fields.

D2: LastAdminPaths row shape is {id, site, class, action, guard, guard_call, reason} (design gave {file, function, arity, class, action | reason}); site is %{file, function: {name, arity}} like BindingWriters. P19 is 5 rows (p19a..p19e).

D3: P1 refusal is recorded through TenantAdminGuard.refuse/3 (which calls record_guard_refused with reason_code and resource_type 'user') rather than calling record_guard_refused/2 directly; same event, and the function error comes back as {:error, :last_interactive_tenant_wide_admin}.

D4: docs test: the 'last paragraph' test now also asserts A12 once after A11 and the Amendment 4 heading; the new row (0) checks are A12 once, A12 after A11, no A13, A10 once with its needle (named :record_a12_not_exactly_once, :record_a12_not_after_a11, :record_has_an_unexpected_a13, :record_a10_edited, helper a12_after_a11?/1). The A12 text claims of design section 13 and the new Gate-paragraph claims (last_interactive_tenant_wide_admin, 'the guard cannot see an administrator who exists in Letflow', no '(still open)') are NOT yet pinned: left to TEST-DESIGNER.

D5: runbook/roles.md intro sentence now says 'the guard that prevents the gap is built, GH #2869 part (a), 0051 A12' and ends 'A12 records the GH #2869 last-admin guard.' (design said drop the 'still open' clause and keep #2869).
D6: Python edit scripts rewrote lib files with LF line endings where the working copy had CRLF; git normalises (diff is content-only). No functional effect.
